reviews.review:
This is a fun puzzle game.
I like Train based games, and if they have puzzles, great. (Train Valley series being the pinnacle).

This game took me a little effort to get really interested, once I did I wasn't going to let it beat me.
Some scenarios are really difficult, some were easy, not always the ones you expect.
I guess my brain can sometimes see a solution for a difficult puzzle and sometimes it cannot.

I loved the fact that if you get really stuck you can get the solution shown to you.
I loved the mechanics, and just the general feel of the game.
I recorded myself playing, and put them on YouTube - link to the first one
https://youtu.be/4AiWjn4dfi0

Only points I mention for improvement,
I would have preferred more intermediate levels and fewer Extreme levels
The help screen for zooming in and panning came up too often and annoyed me, I would prefer that to be adjusted.

Overall this was a fun train puzzle game, that occupied 13 hours for a cheap price, I enjoyed playing it and it was addictive enough that I wanted to finish all 75 scenarios.

Fun, good value and I am happy to recommend it.
